correctness.rationale: Take m=2d and integral cyclic companion A of x^m+k. Direct linear algebra gives det A=k, A^m=-kI and m simple nonreal eigenvalues, each modulus r=k^(1/m)>1. Pair complex-conjugate eigenlines into invariant real planes; on each choose a complex structure J commuting with rotation-scaling rR_θ, and choose an orthogonal basis making A an exact similarity. J and the resulting flat Hermitian inner product are constant and descend to R^m/Z^m even when J is not lattice-integral, so A defines a holomorphic expanding torus self-cover of degree k. Independent exact integer determinant calculations in d=1,2,3,5, k=2,3,7 and several n reproduced det(I-A^n)=[1-(-k)^(n/g)]^g, g=gcd(n,m); the cyclotomic root multiset argument proves all d,k,n. Necessity degree≥2 follows the covering-change-of-variables Jacobian lower bound λ^(2d)>1. Generic torus fixed-point determinant facts are explicitly credited, not rediscovered.
